notes: Only 1f917 hugging and 1f914 thinking exist as blobs, so 7.1 stays the subgroup pick; the other 5 are round fallbacks. Android-16 is the one era where every tile here is a non-bordered redraw (none =11, unlike android-12 where 1f917/1f92d/1f92b are =11 and 1f914 is a bordered retouch), so it is the better source for the 5 round faces: against latest the tiles are the same drawings, but android-16 is flatter/less glossy (softer blush, thinner and lighter hand outlines, less saturated rim shading); latest is a touch darker and more outlined. Hence 1f92d and 1f92b override to android-16 instead of latest. If the default chain puts android-16 before latest, those two overrides become redundant (android-12 =11 is skipped, android-16 is next) and 1fae2/1fae3/1fae1 also resolve to android-16 automatically, giving a uniform round set; if the chain stays [android-12, latest], 1fae2/1fae3/1fae1 stay latest and the overrides keep the pair on android-16, a slightly mixed look. A recommended of android-16 for the whole subgroup would unify all 7 round but give up the two blobs that match neighbouring subgroups, so not taken. All 7 keys are Emoji 17 or earlier: no Emoji 18 gap. android-16 before latest: yes. 1f914 android-12 is a minor retouch of the bordered art (not =11 but same look), so still avoid it. round_fallbacks lists every emoji here that ends up as a flat round face (unbordered, so not redraw-mandatory; optional blob-redraw backlog).
